items.title: Tyrese Haliburton just came out of the tunnel with pep in his step. Took a seat on the bench, appears to be in a good mood and just celebrated an Obi Toppin 3. First starter back with the team - the rest still back in the locker room.
items.author: Tony East
items.body_excerpt: Tyrese Haliburton just came out of the tunnel with pep in his step. Took a seat on the bench, appears to be in a good mood and just celebrated an Obi Toppin 3. First starter back with the team - the rest still back in the locker room.

quote.author: Tony East
quote.text: Haliburton walks off the court somewhat gingerly — nothing too abnormal — as halftime arrives. He had 17 points and 6 assists in the first half. I'd be surprised if he played in the second half. Pacers up 71-56.

items.title: Obi Toppin was warming up, then Rick Carlisle walked over and said something to him and he went back to the locker room. Carlisle then chatted with Jalen Slawson, who removed his wamrups. Looks like it will be no more starters + Toppin. Slawson-Sheppard-Walker-QJackson-Huff now.
